title: Motorola's GrapheneOS phones will launch in 2027 priced higher than Pixels
summary: The private Android-based OS will expand beyond Pixels next year.
llm_summary: Motorola is set to debut its own line of smartphones running GrapheneOS—a privacy‑focused, Android‑based operating system—starting in 2027. Unlike the current GrapheneOS devices, which are limited to Google Pixel phones, Motorola’s versions will be the first to bring the OS to non‑Pixel hardware, and they’ll carry a price tag higher than the comparable Pixel models.
